page: Google Cloud Platform c3-standard-88-lssd is a storage-intensive, general-purpose server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor. It features 88 vCPUs across 44 physical cores with hyper-threading, operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The system is configured with 352 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. A primary hardware differentiator is the inclusion of 16 local NVMe SSDs, providing a total of 6432 GB of high-speed local storage directly attached to the instance.

In performance benchmarks, this instance demonstrates strong multi-core capabilities, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory subsystem performance is also highly rated, with read and write bandwidth benchmarks consistently reaching the top 25% tier. The hardware excels in specialized tasks, achieving top-tier performance in Geekbench image processing and small-model LLM prompt processing, alongside strong results in database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving.

The underlying x86_64 architecture supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which accelerate matrix math and integer operations. While single-core performance benchmarks sit in the average tier, the massive parallel execution capacity and high-density local NVMe storage make this instance highly cost-efficient for resource-dense, I/O-heavy workloads. It is well-suited for large-scale databases, high-throughput web serving, data processing pipelines, and localized machine learning inference tasks.
